# Vendored SpessaSynth (SoundFont synthesizer)

Unmodified copies, except that the two bare imports at the top of `spessasynth_core.js` point to the files next to it.

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spessasynth_core.js` | spessasynth_core (github.com/spessasus/spessasynth_core) | 4.4.10 | Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE-spessasynth_core`) |
| `stb-vorbis.js` | stb-vorbis (github.com/spessasus/stb-vorbis, wraps public-domain stb_vorbis) | 0.0.7 | Apache-2.0 |
| `fflate.js` | fflate `esm/browser.js` | 0.8.3 | MIT (`/LICENSES/fflate.txt`) |

The Apache-2.0 text is also in `/LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt`; the packages ship no NOTICE file. Chosen in `plan/local-preview/sf2-decision.md`. Nothing uses it yet: the voice built on it is chunk 4.8 step 2.
